description: Add a construction plane offset from a default plane, a face, or another plane.

base_ids.description: Deterministic ids of the plane or face to offset from.

base_plane.description: Default plane to offset from (default Front).

base_query.description: FeatureScript query selecting the base plane or face.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Offset plane").

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_offset_plane
title: Create an offset plane
